# Subclipse feature

Packaging: `eclipse-feature`. This optional installable feature groups Subclipse core and UI bundles and requires the base eReviewBoard and Subclipse features. It does not contain SVN implementation code. Its exact dependency versions and included plugins live in [feature.xml](../../org.review_board.ereviewboard.subclipse/feature.xml); the [update site](../org.review_board.ereviewboard.update/overview.md) catalogs it.

See [Subclipse core](../org.review_board.ereviewboard.subclipse.core/overview.md) for base-file lookup and [Subclipse UI](../org.review_board.ereviewboard.subclipse.ui/overview.md) for SVN actions and diff generation.
